steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility

Review PMI's specific thresholds for your background—secondary degree holders and bachelor's-degree holders face different requirements. Granite PM Academy's advisors can verify your qualifications before you enroll.

steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course, delivered by active certified practitioners. Attend sessions from anywhere in Roanoke on a flexible schedule that fits your work at Carilion Clinic, Norfolk Southern, or other local employers. steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing Granite PM Academy's training, prepare and submit your formal PMP application directly to PMI. Include your education credentials, project experience documentation, and payment of PMI's exam fee. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on application requirements and deadlines.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, practice exams, and study guides to reinforce course material. Schedule your proctored exam when ready. The PMP® exam tests your knowledge of project-management frameworks, tools, and real-world scenarios across five domains.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: After passing, commit to PMI's standard three-year renewal cycle by earning professional development units (PDUs) through training, certifications, and project work. Renew your credential on schedule to keep your PMP® designation active and competitive in your local job market.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.
